title: Local activity or club discovery for a new city
description: Research local clubs, activities, and events that match stated interests in a new city, filter them to what actually fits, and rank the results.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: local-activity-discovery
  title: Local activity or club discovery for a new city
  description: Research local clubs, activities, and events that match stated interests in a new city, filter them to what actually fits, and rank the results.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Help someone new to a city find and prioritize local clubs, activities, or events that match their interests and constraints.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Interests, city, and constraints
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: "The person's interests or hobbies, the city or neighborhood they're in, and any distance, schedule, or budget constraints." }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: research
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Local activity researcher
      role: Researcher who finds local clubs, activities, and events matching stated interests.
      prompt: Look for clubs, meetups, classes, or recurring events in the stated city that match the person's stated interests. For each candidate, note what it is, where and when it meets, and what makes it a plausible fit. Do not invent specific listings you cannot support; describe how to search for and verify them instead.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [candidates], properties: { candidates: { type: array, items: { type: object } } } }
    - id: filter
      kind: transform
      name: Filter by distance and schedule
      config: { operation: filter, expression: "keep only candidates that satisfy the stated distance, schedule, and budget constraints" }
    - id: rank
      kind: aggregator
      name: Ranked activity list with rationale
      config: { aggregation: collect }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Ranked local activities
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: research, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: research, to: filter, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: filter, to: rank, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: rank, to: result, kind: data }
